WITH bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
bucket_shares AS (
  SELECT order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM bucket_counts
),
kept AS (
  SELECT share
  FROM bucket_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM bucket_shares)
)
SELECT SUM((SELECT order_count FROM bucket_counts WHERE order_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM bucket_counts) = kept.share)) AS total_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM bucket_shares)) AS average_excess
FROM kept
